summary: A Yes vote raises the City of Scotts Valley's transient occupancy (hotel/motel) tax from 11 percent to 13 percent, with revenue going to the City General Fund.

tax.text: A Yes vote raises the hotel tax from 11% to 13% and generates additional revenue for the City's General Fund.
tax.quote: Measure G raises the hotel tax from 11% to 13%, generating an estimated $300,000 to $400,000 annually for the City's General Fund starting in 2027.

tax.text: A No vote keeps the hotel tax at its current rate and does not generate this additional revenue.
